description: Source code for E2SM-CCC ASN.1 packer, including functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, handling control requests, and packing RAN function descriptions.

classes.name: e2sm_ccc_asn1_packer
classes.description: Class responsible for packing and handling E2SM-CCC messages, including control requests and RAN function descriptions.

methods.name: add_e2sm_control_service
methods.description: Adds a control service to the packer's internal collection.

methods.name: handle_packed_event_trigger_definition
methods.description: Handles packed event trigger definitions; currently not supported.

methods.name: handle_packed_e2sm_action_definition
methods.description: Handles packed E2SM action definitions; currently not supported.

methods.name: handle_packed_ric_control_request
methods.description: Processes a packed RIC control request, extracting headers and messages.

methods.name: pack_ric_control_response
methods.description: Creates a packed RIC control response message based on the input.

methods.name: pack_ran_function_description
methods.description: Generates a packed RAN function description with static configuration data.
